usedFor: lemcal holds booked meetings, and HubSpot holds the deals that “Create Deal” opens for them.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in lemcal, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each new meeting opens a deal, so booked calls show in the pipeline without manual logging.

watchOut: “Update Contact” updates by email, so “New Meeting” only changes people who already exist in HubSpot.
